problem: Choose how to store user passwords in a new web service
context: Python service, about 50k users expected. Passwords are only ever verified, never shown or recovered.
constraints: A database leak must not reveal passwords quickly

options.summary: Hash with argon2id using the argon2-cffi library's default parameters
Store SHA-256 of a per-user random salt concatenated with the password
Encrypt passwords with AES-256-GCM using a key held in the secrets manager

criteria.description: Resistance to offline cracking after a database leak

expected.why: Control case. Fast hashes crack quickly; encryption is reversible if the key leaks too.
